page.overview:
What is Akurion?

Akurion is a fictional location created by the late American author Howard Phillips Lovecraft for his 1920 short story "The Doom That Came to Sarnath."

Akurion is the name given by the people of the city of Sarnath to a tall grey rock that served as a tidal marker near the shore of the unnamed lake where Sarnath once stood. (: "The Doom That Came to Sarnath")
